title_original: 충청북도 청주시 설치 및 지원특례에 관한 법률
full_text:
Article 4 (Implementation of Measures for Mutually Beneficial Development, etc.)
(1) The Mayor of Cheongju-si shall faithfully implement the measures for mutually beneficial development agreed upon by the heads of Cheongju-si and Cheongwon-gun before consolidation (hereinafter referred to as the "former city and county").
(2) A Mutually Beneficial Development Committee shall be established under the Mayor of Cheongju-si to inspect implementation of the measures for mutually beneficial development.
(3) Specific matters concerning implementation of the measures for mutually beneficial development and the composition and operation of the Mutually Beneficial Development Committee shall be prescribed by municipal ordinance.
